title: Apple Fitness Ring Closure Dip After Travel
app: COROS, Wahoo ELEMNT, TrainerRoad, Apple Fitness / HealthKit exports, Concept2 Logbook, Strava, Garmin Connect, and Zwift activity feeds via official APIs, FIT/CSV exports, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=applefitness:workout
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(move_pct) as move_pct, max(exercise_min) as exercise_min, max(stand_pct) as stand_pct by athlete _time
| where move_pct<70 OR exercise_min<20 OR stand_pct<80
| sort - _time
description: Uses Apple Fitness exports telemetry to monitor daily ring closure after trips or disrupted routines in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for travel weeks where baseline movement fell away, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Apple Fitness exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a weekly cadence.
visualization: Daily table of move, exercise, and stand percentages.
grandmaExplanation: It flags daily ring closure after trips or disrupted routines so you can spot travel weeks where baseline movement fell away before it becomes annoying.
